criteria.bankruptcy: r<=-1: equity frozen at zero, drawdown=1, report time
criteria.contribution_trim: Top ceil(.01*N) valid symbol-period contributions in normal periods; ties time then symbol ascending. Subtract from original period returns, keep costs, cash periods, weights and period denominator; no redistribution.
criteria.zero_sd: t=null; positive mean passes t gate; n>=100 still required

limitations: DESIGN pool already used for D98 and D101; not holdout validation.
No weight drift; turnover understated; no liquidation, risk tiers or ADL model.
Independent-period t statistic ignores serial correlation.
Invalid outcomes use future completeness, zero contribution without redistribution; entire invalid periods and their costs are excluded, subject to the 5% ceiling.
Settlement history, not forecast funding, is used.
All symbols execute at the same hourly opening timestamp.

rules.basket: Sort (-F,symbol), first floor(n/5) short, last floor(n/5) long, signed weights +/-0.5/k; n<25 is cash, close all previous holdings.
rules.cash: Cash return=-close cost; included in all period statistics.
rules.cost: sum(abs(a_new-b_prev)*(c+s)); s=current eligible tier or last eligible rebalance tier, charged to the period starting at t. b is prior target with delisted symbols zeroed. Final liquidation uses surviving b and t_last tiers.
rules.delist: Allowed D98 tail, Ea<=e: exit at close(La)*(1-d*0.02); tau=Ea uses close(La), later funding ignored; fee=w*c, remaining holding zero.
rules.eligibility: Active DESIGN contract, launch age>=60d, complete [t-31d,t) hourly bars, at least one funding in (t-7d,t]. Reasons: zero_mean, liquidity, funding_coverage.
rules.funding: f=-d*sum(rate*O(tau)/O(t)), t<tau<=e; preceding settlement and all consecutive intervals and final endpoint must be within 8h.
rules.grid: t=start+j*H days, t+H<=end; eligibility counted daily on [start,end).
rules.invalid: Missing entry/exit/funding price or funding gap: contribution zero, no redistribution, costs and target retained unless delisted. Entire leg invalid makes period invalid, excluded from statistics but retained in invalid counters.
rules.price: g=d*(O(e)/O(t)-1), fixed entry notional; ignore weight drift.
rules.score: Mean(rate*8h/preceding interval) over (t-L,t]; predecessor required, interval in {1,2,4,8}h, last settlement age<=8h. Both L=1/7 must pass.
